tools.name: deployments_upload
tools.description:
Deploy a static site to a live URL: free, no account or API key required.

**File content is plain text by default.** Pass HTML/CSS/JS/JSON/SVG/etc. directly in each file's `content` as a regular string. Only set `encoding: "base64"` per-file for binary content (images, fonts) — do not base64-encode

tools.name: deployments_list
tools.description: List all deployments with their URLs, status, labels, and password protection state. The response's `cursor` is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` to fetch the next.

tools.name: deployments_get
tools.description: Get deployment details including URL, status, file count, size, labels, and password protection state.

tools.name: deployments_set
tools.description: Update deployment labels. Replaces all existing labels.

tools.name: deployments_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes a deployment and its files.

tools.name: domains_set
tools.description: Create or update a domain: a ShipStatic domain (e.g. "yourname.shipstatic.com"), live as soon as a deployment is linked, or a custom domain (e.g. "www.example.com"), which needs DNS records first. Can reserve a name (omit deployment), link it to a deployment, switch deployments, or update labels. Fo

tools.name: domains_list
tools.description: List all domains with their URLs, linked deployment, and `status`. The response's `cursor` is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` to fetch the next.

tools.name: domains_get
tools.description: Get domain details including URL, linked deployment, labels, and `status`: the one word saying what the domain needs from its owner (`unverified`, `unlinked`, `live`, `paused`).

tools.name: domains_records
tools.description: Returns the DNS records to configure at the domain's DNS provider. Call after domains_set. Custom domains only: a ShipStatic domain has no records to configure.

tools.name: domains_dns
tools.description: Returns the DNS provider recorded for the domain, if known (e.g. Cloudflare, Namecheap): where its DNS records are configured. Custom domains only, and only while the domain is unverified; once its DNS is right there is nothing left to locate.

tools.name: domains_share
tools.description: Returns a shareable DNS setup URL that needs no API key, for whoever manages the domain's DNS. Custom domains only, and only while the domain is unverified; a verified domain has no setup left to share.

tools.name: domains_validate
tools.description: Check if a domain name is valid and available before creating it. Returns the normalized form and availability.

tools.name: domains_verify
tools.description: Trigger DNS verification for a custom domain. Call after the user has configured DNS records from domains_records. Custom domains only, and refused once the domain is verified: read domains_get instead. Verification is asynchronous: read the domain again with domains_get to learn the verdict, since

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns your email and name, and the account's plan, usage and caps.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.shipstatic.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deployments_list, deployments_get, domains_list, domains_get · Private data: deployments_upload, deployments_list, deployments_get, deployments_delete, domains_set, domains_records, domains_dns, domains_share, domains_verify · Public sink: deployments_upload, domains_share, whoami · Destructive: deployments_delete, domains_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deployments_list, deployments_get, domains_list, domains_get · Private data: deployments_upload, deployments_list, deployments_get, deployments_delete, domains_set, domains_records, domains_dns, domains_share, domains_verify · Public sink: deployments_upload, domains_share, whoami · Destructive: deployments_delete, domains_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
